name: Hash Generator
tagline: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 from text or files.
description: Generate cryptographic hashes from text or files directly in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

seo.title: Online Hash Generator — MD5, SHA-256, SHA-512
seo.description: Free online hash generator for text and files. MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512, computed locally in your browser.

content.technical: SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 use the browser's Web Crypto API. MD5 and SHA-1 are provided for compatibility and legacy use, not for security-sensitive applications.
content.privacy: Everything runs locally in your browser. Your text and files are never sent to a server.
instructions: Pick an algorithm. SHA-256 is a good default.
Click Generate hash, then copy the result.

faq.question: Is my text or file uploaded anywhere?
faq.answer: No. Hashing runs in your browser. Large inputs are processed in a Web Worker, still on your device.

faq.question: Which algorithm should I use?
faq.answer: Use SHA-256 or stronger for integrity checks. MD5 and SHA-1 are only for compatibility with legacy systems and checksums.

faq.question: Why do I get a different hash somewhere else?
faq.answer: Text is hashed as UTF-8. A trailing newline, extra spaces or a different encoding change the result.

faq.question: Is there a file size limit?
faq.answer: Files up to 512 MB, because the browser reads the whole file into memory to compute SHA hashes.
